title: Apple Cheese Danish
description: Packaged puff pastry encases a sweet cottage cheese-cream cheese filling topped with apples and baked until golden in this impressive breakfast treat.
ingredients: 3 apples - peeled, cored and thinly sliced
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, at room temperature
1 (17.5 ounce) package frozen puff pastry, thawed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

Place cottage cheese in a strainer lined with cheesecloth or heavy-duty paper towels. Let drain 5 to 10 minutes. Pat dry with paper towels; set aside. Place apples in a medium bowl; toss with lemon juice.
Combine cottage cheese, cream cheese,1/2 cup sugar, egg, and vanilla extract in the bowl of an electric mixer. Mix on high speed until almost smooth, 1 to 2 minutes.
Cut each puff pastry sheet into 9 pieces. Roll each piece into a 5 x 5-inch square.

Place a square in front of you so that it looks like a diamond. Spoon a generous amount of cheese filling down middle of each square, leaving 1/4 inch border at top and bottom edges. Fan out 4 to 5 slices of apple on top of cheese. Bring left and right corners together to meet in center; pinch to seal.
Transfer to a baking sheet; repeat with remaining pastries; sprinkle with 3 tablespoons sugar. Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
